cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
project(GokakuNativeTests LANGUAGES CXX)

# Use the same output directory per configuration regardless of the generator.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/$<CONFIG>")

# Refer to the header generated by the production build and the engine C++ sources.
set(ENGINE_CPP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../deepshogi/native/cpp")
if(NOT EXISTS "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Config.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Config.h is missing. Run python src/build.py first.")
endif()

# Compile the board and PN search implementation once and use it from each executable.
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(pnsearch_test_engine STATIC
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/BitBoard.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Board.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/BoardHash.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Constant.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Move.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/MoveResult.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/PnSearchCache.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/PnSearchEngine.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/PnSearchManager.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/PnSearchNode.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Position.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(pnsearch_test_engine PUBLIC "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(pnsearch_test_engine PUBLIC Threads::Threads)

# target is the name of the corresponding C++ file without its extension.
function(add_native_test_executable target)
  add_executable(${target} "${target}.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE pnsearch_test_engine)

  # Evaluate test assertions in the release configuration as well.
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
endfunction()

foreach(target IN ITEMS
    dfpn_benchmark
    dfpn_native_test
    pnsearch_abort_native_test
    pnsearch_cache_native_test
    pnsearch_moves_native_test
    pnsearch_native_test)
  add_native_test_executable(${target})
endforeach()

# Link the inference result cache, which does not require LibTorch.
add_native_test_executable(inference_cache_test)
target_sources(inference_cache_test PRIVATE
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceCache.cpp"
  "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceHash.cpp"
)

# Link the inference and search implementation and LibTorch needed by the Player test.
option(DEEPSHOGI_TEST_PLAYER "Build the Player regression test" OFF)
if(DEEPSHOGI_TEST_PLAYER)
  find_package(Torch CONFIG REQUIRED)

  # Compile the shared board and search code with the same C++ ABI as LibTorch.
  separate_arguments(TORCH_COMPILE_OPTIONS NATIVE_COMMAND "${TORCH_CXX_FLAGS}")
  target_compile_options(pnsearch_test_engine PUBLIC ${TORCH_COMPILE_OPTIONS})

  add_native_test_executable(player_wait_native_test)
  target_sources(player_wait_native_test PRIVATE
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Candidate.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceCache.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceExecutor.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceHash.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceModel.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/InferenceProcessor.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/MctsManager.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/MctsNode.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/MctsParameter.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/MctsPolicy.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/MctsValue.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/Player.cpp"
    "${ENGINE_CPP_DIR}/ThreadPool.cpp"
  )
  target_include_directories(player_wait_native_test SYSTEM PRIVATE ${TORCH_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(player_wait_native_test PRIVATE ${TORCH_LIBRARIES})
endif()
